name: Khudiram Bose
tagline: Khudiram Bose was an inspirational pioneer from West Bengal who contributed crucially to Freedom Struggle.
short_bio: One of the youngest revolutionaries of the Indian independence movement, martyred at age 18 in Muzaffarpur.
is_unsung_reason: Despite their monumental sacrifices for West Bengal and the Indian nation, their story was overshadowed in national school textbooks.

contributions.title: Contribution Milestone 1
contributions.description: Active leader in the Anushilan Samiti revolutionary organisation.

contributions.title: Contribution Milestone 2
contributions.description: Muzaffarpur action against oppressive colonial magistrate Douglas Kingsford.

contributions.title: Contribution Milestone 3
contributions.description: Embraced the gallows smiling at just 18 years old, igniting Bengali revolutionary songs.

timeline_events.title: Legacy of Khudiram Bose
timeline_events.description: Immortalized in Indian history for selfless service to the nation.

sources.title: National Archives of India (Muzaffarpur Conspiracy Case File); PIB Bengal Martyrs Series.

name: Akkamma Cherian
tagline: Akkamma Cherian was an inspirational pioneer from Kerala who contributed crucially to Freedom Struggle.
short_bio: Indian independence activist and feminist leader from Travancore affectionately hailed as the "Jhansi Rani of Travancore" by Mahatma Gandhi.
is_unsung_reason: Despite their monumental sacrifices for Kerala and the Indian nation, their story was overshadowed in national school textbooks.

contributions.title: Contribution Milestone 1
contributions.description: Led 20,000 peaceful demonstrators against the autocratic Diwan CP Ramaswamy Iyer.

contributions.title: Contribution Milestone 2
contributions.description: Famously dared the police inspector to shoot her first when military troops opened fire.

contributions.title: Contribution Milestone 3
contributions.description: Formed the Desasevini Sangh volunteer brigade for women independence workers.

timeline_events.title: Legacy of Akkamma Cherian
timeline_events.description: Immortalized in Indian history for selfless service to the nation.

sources.title: Kerala State Archives gazetteer; PIB Women Freedom Fighters of India.

name: Krishnaji Gopal Karve
tagline: Krishnaji Gopal Karve was an inspirational pioneer from Maharashtra who contributed crucially to Freedom Struggle.
short_bio: Revolutionary freedom fighter from Nashik associated with the Abhinav Bharat Society founded by Veer Savarkar.
is_unsung_reason: Despite their monumental sacrifices for Maharashtra and the Indian nation, their story was overshadowed in national school textbooks.

contributions.title: Contribution Milestone 1
contributions.description: Key member of the Abhinav Bharat revolutionary society in Maharashtra.

contributions.title: Contribution Milestone 2
contributions.description: Assassinated the oppressive British Collector A.M.T. Jackson in Nashik in December 1909.

contributions.title: Contribution Milestone 3
contributions.description: Executed by the British regime at Thane Jail in 1910.

timeline_events.title: Legacy of Krishnaji Gopal Karve
timeline_events.description: Immortalized in Indian history for selfless service to the nation.

sources.title: Maharashtra State Archives; Abhinav Bharat Historical Society records.

name: Bina Das
tagline: The fearlessly defiant revolutionary who fired at Bengal Governor Stanley Jackson at age 21.
short_bio: Bina Das was an Indian revolutionary and nationalist from West Bengal who attempted to assassinate the British Governor of Bengal Stanley Jackson in 1932 at the Calcutta University convocation.
is_unsung_reason: Her supreme courage and years of rigorous imprisonment were eclipsed in post-independence national textbooks.

contributions.title: Contribution Milestone 1
contributions.description: Fired shots at Governor Stanley Jackson during the Calcutta University convocation ceremony.

contributions.title: Contribution Milestone 2
contributions.description: Active leader of Chhatri Sangha women student resistance movement in Bengal.

contributions.title: Contribution Milestone 3
contributions.description: Awarded Padma Shri in 1960 for lifelong dedicated social welfare work.

timeline_events.title: Legacy of Bina Das
timeline_events.description: Immortalized in Indian history for selfless service to the nation.

sources.title: Autobiography 'Shrinkhal Jhankar'; National Archives of India; Calcutta Police Special Branch records.
